title: Build a Visual Data Center Model
summary: Show someone who has never seen a data center how its systems and people fit together.
objectives: Represent servers, networking, electricity, cooling, security, and people.
Explain how the systems connect and name one opportunity and one community question.

vocab.def: A drawing, arrangement, or other representation that helps explain how something works.
Parts that work together for a purpose.

sections.heading: Your design challenge
sections.body: Create a visual model of a data center using paper, a slide, a diagram, craft materials, or another accessible format. Include servers, networking, electricity, cooling, security, and the people who support them.

sections.heading: Explain the connections
sections.body: Use arrows, labels, or a short explanation to show how the systems work together. Your model does not need to look like a professional building plan.

sections.heading: Add the community view
sections.body: Include one possible opportunity and one question a community might ask. Explain why both belong in a thoughtful model.

practice.prompt: Sketch six labeled parts before building your final model. Check that every part has a connection or purpose.

project.title: Build a Visual Data Center Model
submissionOptions: oral explanation with a labeled visual
rubric: includes an opportunity and a community question

quiz.question: What should the model help you explain?
options: How systems and people work together
quiz.answer: How systems and people work together

levels: Proficient: explains several systems and a community question

reflectionPrompt: What part of your model best explains the physical world behind the internet?
